Q: Laravel validation rule for domain name A:

For supporting domains with symbols in local alphabets and symbols "-", "_":

/^(?:[\p{L}\d_-](?:[\p{L}\d_-]{0,61}[\p{L}\d_-])?\.)+[\p{L}\d_-]{1,63}$/u
